text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By chance, I spotted Nishino Flower heading back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm done with my classroom monitor duties,
and I handed in those handouts too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Since there's no homework today, I can take my time tending to the flowers in my room...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!!
I totally forgot to water the flower bed!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To think I forgot something so important...!
I'm so sorry, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps fatigue has built up from running in consecutive races. It looks like we'll need to reconsider our upcoming schedule."
